description: Regression values of this repository for DMD (rank 20) of 100 snapshots (t = 150 to 200, one per 0.5 time units) of the Re=100 limit cycle. The first oscillatory pair after the near-Nyquist pair sits at the shedding frequency St = 0.166 (literature value for the 2D cylinder at Re = 100: about 0.165) and its first harmonic follows at twice that value.
